title: You will learn, for example:
main_content:
You will learn, for example:

• To create and edit projects
• Recording printed and digital media manually and automatically
• Navigating and searching in the reference management system
• Creating list of references and publications
The presentation will be in German. No registration necessary.

Venue: Zentralbibliothek Zurich , seminar room B
